questions.question: Solve the following expression: (1/cosA) * [sin(60 0 + A) + sin(60 0 - A)]. निम्न अभिव्यक्ति को हल करें: (1/cosA) * [sin(60 0 + A) + sin(60 0 - A)].
questions.solution:
= (1/cosA) * [sin(600 + A) + sin(600 - A)]

= (1/cosA) * [(sin600.cosA + cos600.sinA) + (sin600.cosA - cos600.sinA)]

= (1/cosA) * [(√3/2) * cosA + (√3/2) * cosA]

= (1/cosA) * (√3cosA)

= √3
